prereg.written: 2026-09-28 (before any E2/E5/E6 result existed; chain not yet launched)
prereg.rule_E2: Pre-registered (author-approved): let F = mean_force_c(C+W) / mean_force_c(A3), the ratio of the population means of the geometry-mean energy error under consistent tractions (class force_c), identity view (view 0), over the 80 validation geometries (SPLIT_ARMS val_s3), C+W = the A0_ctrl checkpoint evaluated with the correction W applied at evaluation only, A3 = A3_2grid (NICE). If F <= 1.1 (C+W within 10% of A3), contribution (ii) ('training through the correction') is downgraded. The binding statistic is the point value F on all 80 geometries from the new E2a run; 95% paired-bootstrap CI over geometries (20,000 resamples, seed 0), the 60 non-selection geometries, the strata and the pair maxima are reported alongside but do not change the rule's outcome.

statistic.denominator: newval3_A3.json mean[0][force_c] (fresh re-evaluation; archived newval2_A3_2grid 0.0007374530509589698 as cross-check)

secondary_reported_not_binding: F with 95% bootstrap CI (VERIFY_T6: CI including 1 also argues against the attribution)
(B+W)/(C+W) = continuation share, (C+W)/A3 = training-through share, per class and stratum
pair maxima (compliance, sensitivity) for A3, B+W, C+W on all archived pair configurations
prereg.W_note: identical to A3_2grid cfg model_args (smooth_k 8, smooth_alpha 30.0, coarse_space Q1_17) and to the B+W override of chain_p1 / chain_p1c
prereg.E5: per-direction energy errors for A3, BW, C, CW on the 80 geometries, view 0, validation banks (all directions stored)

E6.selection: 9 test cells, all sel=false in evidence/valmeta.json: the 5 largest A3 force_c geometry means (VERIFY_T3: 2051, 2045, 2074, 2021, 2063) plus one cell per stratum (FULL; light vol>2/3; moderate 1/3<vol<=2/3; heavy vol<=1/3) drawn uniformly from the remaining sel=false cells of that stratum (sorted case ids) with numpy default_rng(20260928), one rng.choice per stratum in the order FULL, light, moderate, heavy
E6.configs: x and y for every cell (18 configurations), neighbour = the cell's own exact continuous-thickness packet <case>_nbmx / _nbmy (lat_full --nb-mode explicit --sets test)
E6.reporting: every configuration is reported, including failures (exception recorded), PCG at the 400-iteration cap, negative energy share and non-finite errors; aggregates are given over well-posed configurations with the excluded ones listed

prereg.precision: fp32 network forward with true-fp32 convolutions (OPL_CONV_FP32=1, cudnn.allow_tf32 False, matmul allow_tf32 False), fp64 energies, wrapper, reference and PCG; no TF32/fp16/bf16
revisions: 2026-09-28, before launch and before any result: E6 arms reduced to A3 and BW (as specified; C+W not run on held-out pairs to keep the GPU queue short)
